thread:
Sam: noticed some tenants showing negative cache savings on the 7d card after yesterday's release. sample tenant: t-9921 shows -$9.12.
Rina: hmm, likely the shared-prefetch amortization timing again. did we switch the dashboard to the stream source?
Ethan: yes, dash queries `prefetch_stream` for realtime. reconciler writes to `prefetch_reconciled_mv` later. mixing causes temporary negatives.
Sam: Product asked for a single friendly number. they hate negatives unless it's an actual loss.
Jin: proposal: show a conservative summary number = max(point_estimate, 0) for main view, but include a small chevron that expands to raw value, sample_count, and reconciled_at. add an "advanced: show raw" toggle.
Rina: also add a sample threshold: if sample_count < 60 show "insufficient samples" instead of 0. reduces noise.
Ethan: backend changes: add `reconciled_at`, `sample_count`, and `raw_prefetch_savings` to the MV. expose API param `freshness=live|reconciled`.
Sam: UI should surface why clamping happened. small tooltip: "Amortized cache credits are reconciled periodically; small samples may produce transient negative raw values."
Jin: for safety, add CI smoke that fails deploy if any tenant has savings < -0.02 * monthly_cost and is `reconciled_at` null or recent (<1h).
Rina: optional smoothing mode: `smoothing=ewma` exposed via API for power users. default stays conservative.
Ethan: estimate: MV migration + backfill ~ half day, API + tests ~ half day, UI clamp + chevron ~ 1 day, telemetry + smoke ~ few hrs.
Sam: can we ship clamp + reconciled flag this week? product wants quick fix.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: reconciler-mv-bump/2026-03-22T16:00Z -> staging (by @Ethan) :gear: 
Jin: i'll open the UI PR with the chevron and tooltip. will include telemetry events: econ.card.clamped, econ.card.view_raw.
Rina: i'll own the CI smoke and runbook note about reconciliation windows.
Sam: thanks team. once staging lands i'll validate tenant t-9921. if expanded raw shows negative but the main shows "insufficient samples" that's fine.
Ethan: PR up for MV change, tests green, staging job queued.
Sam: validated on staging: main card shows "insufficient samples" for t-9921 and expanded view shows raw -$9.12 + reconciled_at null. looks good.
Jin: next sprint follow-up: A/B test EWMA vs reconciled default for PM satisfaction.
Sam: great. closing thread, thanks all. :raised_hands:
